BUSINESS ANALYST & SME OPERATIONAL BLUEPRINT v2.0 41 BIAN PROFILES • 5 DOMAINS

PeX — Payment Exception Resolution: End-to-End Flow

The definitive 20-step lifecycle governing how institutional payment exceptions are ingested, normalized into canonical ISO 20022 schemas, investigated via governed AI, reviewed through tiered Maker-Checker controls, and cryptographically sealed upon RTGS settlement.

Framework Architecture
3 Macro Stages
20 Governed Checkpoints
I STEPS 1 – 5

1. Understand

"What happened?"

Bank detects payment failure, publishes contracted exception event, PeX validates payload, normalizes fields into the Canonical Payment Model, and classifies under the 41 BIAN Exception Taxonomy.

II STEPS 6 – 14

2. Investigate & Recommend

"Why did it happen & what should we do?"

Evidence Planner queries ICD staging adapters, Zero-PII Vault tokenizes sensitive data, Rule Studio enforces policy constraints, deterministic AI reasoner evaluates hypotheses, and a structured recommendation contract is generated.

III STEPS 15 – 20

3. Control & Resolve

"Who approves it, how is it executed, and how is it proven?"

Case File presented to Maker, submitted to Checkers with segregation of duties, dual-authorized if high value, dispatched to clearing rail (CHAPS/Fedwire/Target2), settled, and cryptographically sealed into the SHA-256 audit ledger.
